findings.deal_impact: Domain spoofing could support business email compromise or wire-fraud attempts against the company, customers, or transaction counterparties. Severity unchanged from baseline.

remediation.summary: Move DMARC from monitoring to enforcement, progressing from p=quarantine to p=reject after confirming legitimate senders and DKIM alignment.

findings.title: DMARC not enforced (p=none): domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud

findings.deal_impact: Soft-fail SPF weakens sender authentication and increases phishing and spoofing risk when combined with unenforced DMARC. Severity unchanged from baseline.

remediation.summary: Inventory all authorized mail senders, remove obsolete includes, and change the SPF qualifier from ~all to -all.

findings.title: SPF uses soft/neutral fail

findings.deal_impact: Unsigned DNS responses are more susceptible to spoofing or cache poisoning, although the practical deal risk is lower than the email-authentication findings. Severity unchanged from baseline.

remediation.summary: Enable DNSSEC signing with the DNS provider and registrar, publish DS records, and monitor validation and key rollover.

findings.title: DNSSEC not enabled

findings.deal_impact: Publicly visible VPN, legacy, staging, and old administrative hostnames may expand the attack surface and indicate systems requiring lifecycle or access-control diligence. Presence in certificate logs does not by itself confirm current exposure. Severity unchanged from baseline.

remediation.summary: Validate ownership and business need for each risky hostname, decommission obsolete systems, and place necessary services behind MFA, VPN restrictions, or IP allowlisting.

findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

findings.deal_impact: A 47-hostname certificate footprint for a 201-1000 employee company suggests potential asset sprawl requiring inventory reconciliation during diligence. Severity unchanged from baseline.

remediation.summary: Reconcile certificate-transparency hostnames against the authoritative asset inventory and remove or formally accept unowned, stale, or unmanaged services.

findings.title: Large certificate footprint relative to company size

findings.deal_impact: Deprecated TLS versions on the www host may permit protocol downgrade attacks and create customer or compliance exposure. Severity unchanged from baseline.

remediation.summary: Disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1, retain TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3, and verify client compatibility before enforcement.

findings.title: Deprecated TLS versions offered

findings.deal_impact: Without HSTS, users may be vulnerable to HTTPS downgrade or first-visit interception attacks. Severity unchanged from baseline.

remediation.summary: Add a Strict-Transport-Security header with an appropriate max-age to all HTTPS responses and consider includeSubDomains after validating subdomain readiness.

findings.title: HSTS not set

findings.deal_impact: This is a potential exposure based on a public version fingerprint matched offline to a known-exploited-vulnerability record; it has not been verified on the host. If confirmed, exploitation could create material incident, remediation, and transaction-timeline risk. Severity unchanged from baseline.

evidence.excerpt: ExampleGate SSL-VPN 7.0.11; cve_id: CVE-PLACEHOLDER-0001; basis: version string from public page; not verified on host

remediation.summary: Urgently confirm whether ExampleGate SSL-VPN 7.0.11 is deployed, apply the vendor fix or remove the service from internet exposure, and review authentication and exploitation logs.

findings.title: Potential exposure to a CISA Known Exploited Vulnerability

findings.deal_impact: A disclosed unauthorized-access incident affecting approximately 3,100 notified individuals within the last 24 months raises diligence questions about root cause, remediation, notification obligations, litigation, and recurrence controls. Severity unchanged from baseline.

evidence.excerpt: 2025-08-14 state_ag_breach_notice: Notice filed for unauthorized access to a customer support system; approx. 3,100 individuals notified.

remediation.summary: Obtain the incident report and regulatory correspondence, verify containment and corrective actions, and confirm whether notification, monitoring, legal, or insurance obligations remain open.
